turns.input: Bram Kessel gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Bram Kessel dips a hand into the pocket of his apron and pulls out a worn pair of leather boots, extending them toward Nicco with a grin that crinkles the flour dusting his moustache. "You look like a man who could use solid footing," he says, callused palm open in offer. The boots are scuffed but well-cared-for, the leather softened by years of wear. "From my nephew, outgrew them last harvest. No use to me, and you're welcome to them."

Nicco takes the boots.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Bram Kessel's booming voice cuts off as Nicco speaks, his grey-streaked moustache twitching. He glances down at the boots in Nicco's hands, then back up with a weightlifter's appraising squint. "I gave you those," he says, quieter now, the flour-dusted apron creasing as he folds his thick arms. "Solid footing, I said. You refusing solid footing?"

He does not reach for the boots. The charcoal behind his ear wiggles slightly as he tilts his head, waiting.
